newsitem.title: CANADA: Stelco's Lake Erie mill down for 11 days.
newsitem.headline: Stelco's Lake Erie mill down for 11 days.

text.p: Stelco Inc said on Wednesday that its wholly owned Lake Erie Steel Company Ltd experienced a major failure at its Hot Strip Mill causing an outage of the mill that would continue for the next 11 days.
Stelco said there was an electrical problem with a 6,000 horsepower drive motor on the Roughing Mill.

The steelmaker said all efforts were being made to minimize the impact of the outage on steel supply to its customers. It said the financial impact of the disruption might be offset partly by insurance coverage.
